title: Quantum thermodynamics of ergotopy for a relativistic battery as a witness to Unruh-Hawking thermality in curved (A)dS spacetimes
summary: We propose a relativistic quantum battery model consisting of an accelerated Unruh-DeWitt detector coupled to a massless scalar field in a de Sitter and anti-de Sitter spacetimes. The maximal amount of quantum extractable work, defined as the ergotropy, is used to probe Unruh-Hawking thermality induced by acceleration and spacetime curvature. Using the open quantum system approach, we study the dynamics of the ergotropy with respect to the Kubo-Martin-Schwinger temperature, spacetime boundary conditions, and dimensionality.
